calls.title: Kelvin Fernandes and Scott Keller + Logan Bates
calls.summary: The meeting highlighted GrowthBook’s unique open-source platform, supporting over 3,000 companies with flexibility for various tech stacks and avoiding vendor lock-in. It caters to startups and large enterprises, including AI companies, with deployment options like self-hosting and on-premises setups, essential for regulated industries to manage data privacy. AI-driven workflows enhance ease of use, automating feature flags and accelerating experimentation cycles. Key features include targeted rollouts with monitoring, support for multi-variant testing showing a 6.7% purchase rise, and strong compliance with SOC2 and SSO. Neologics expressed interest in partnership discussions, and the conversation involved examining referral models in conjunction with projects they are handling.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, experimentation, feature management, on-prem integration, product analytics, partnership
calls.action_items:

Investigate existing partner/referral structures and partnership models for GrowthBook to present options to Neologics (28:53)
Schedule a follow-up deep-dive call with Kelvin Fernandes to discuss partnership details and technical aspects involving Neologics’ team (28:35)
Package and send an email summarizing partnership, training, and product information including support and SLA details to Kelvin Fernandes (33:24)
Offer flexible call times to accommodate Kelvin’s schedule, including early morning options if needed (30:35)

**Kelvin Fernandes**
Check calendar availability for follow-up calls, potentially including manager and technical lead for detailed discussion (30:40)
Sign up for a free GrowthBook account to self-explore product features and documentation (32:24)
